Trial of sulfonylurea for minimum 90 days with documented failure or contraindication
3-month log of blood glucose readings showing recurrent hypoglycemic events or sustained HbA1c > 8.0%

expected_reasoning: Patient has documentation satisfying ALL three requirements: (1) Metformin trial of 198 days with documented inadequate control (HbA1c 8.2%) and GI side effects, (2) Glipizide (sulfonylurea) trial of 191 days with documented hypoglycemic episodes and inadequate control (HbA1c 7.8%), (3) 3-month glucose log with 5 documented hypoglycemic events and current HbA1c of 8.5%. The denial under STEP_THERAPY_NOT_SATISFIED appears to be erroneous — the appeal should demonstrate that step therapy was in fact completed.
